# Image Converter

Image Converter is a browser-based tool for converting images between HEIC, PNG, JPEG, and WebP.

Canonical URL: https://convert.imageprivacy.org/

## Features

- Convert HEIC, WebP, JPEG, or PNG images to WebP, JPEG, or PNG
- Choose quality for compressed formats
- Set a background color for JPEG exports
- Process images locally in the browser

## Recommended workflow

Use JPEG for broad compatibility, PNG when transparency or sharp graphics matter, and WebP for smaller modern web images. Reopen the exported file to confirm format, transparency, background color, and visible content before sharing.

## Privacy model

The selected image is converted using browser canvas. Exporting creates a new metadata-light copy.
